_what_this_is: The ONE enumerated list of reviewer-owned pack documents, by EXACT name. Round 28, the challenger's B-10 (P1): manifest-digests.py enumerated them here while test/tool-commands-are-isolated.test.ts described the same set with a name PATTERN, so a document could be reviewer-owned in one instrument and author-owned in the other — and a pattern silently exempts the next file that happens to match it, which is round 23's F-42 reintroduced at the same width. Both instruments now read THIS file. A name is added here when a reviewer announces a report; no pattern, no inference, and a reviewer-looking file that is absent is a PROBLEM rather than an exemption.
